# Okta / Entra / Google direct

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P5 · Enterprise scale](../README.md#phase-5--enterprise-scale) · **Lane:** Identity provider · **Label:** `feature:idp-adapters` · **Epic:** — · **Tickets:** 6 (2S 4M)

Warden resolves a person's groups directly from Okta, Microsoft Entra ID or Google Workspace, so Dex becomes optional. The console, worker identity verification and token service accept ID tokens from one or more configured issuers, and group lookups that the token cannot carry (Entra overage, Google) go through a cached directory adapter.

## How we build it

- New package internal/idp with `type GroupResolver interface { Groups(ctx context.Context, iss, sub string, claims map[string]any) ([]string, error) }` and adapters `claims` (read a configured claim, default `groups`), `okta`, `entra`, `google`; Dex keeps using the `claims` adapter.
- Multi-issuer config block `identity.issuers[]: {name, issuer, clientID, audiences[], groupSource: claims|okta|entra|google, groupsClaim, cacheTTL}`; the OIDC verifier from p1-verify-token becomes a map keyed by `iss`, each with its own JWKS cache; unknown `iss` is rejected (401), never falls through to another issuer.
- Entra: if the token has `_claim_names.groups` / `hasgroups` (overage), call Microsoft Graph `POST /v1.0/users/{oid}/getMemberGroups` with app-only client credentials (`clientSecretEnv` or certificate); group IDs are mapped to display names only if `entra.resolveNames: true`. Okta: `groups` claim from a custom authorization server, optional `GET /api/v1/users/{id}/groups` fallback with an SSWS token from env.
- Google: Admin SDK Directory API `groups.list?userKey=<email>` using a service account with domain-wide delegation (`google.serviceAccountKeyEnv`, `google.adminSubject`); Google ID tokens carry no groups, so this path is mandatory for Google.
- Resolved groups are cached per (iss, sub) for `cacheTTL` (default 10m) with singleflight; on directory API failure the cached value is used up to `staleTTL`, after which role mapping yields no groups (viewer-or-deny, never a widened role). Directory credentials are fetched via internal/secrets and never written to CP state.
- Group strings are namespaced `<issuer-name>:<group>` only when more than one issuer is configured, so p1-sso-roles mappings and p1-group-policy rules stay unambiguous.

## Done when

With Dex removed from the compose stack, a user signing in through Okta, Entra (including an overage account) or Google gets the correct console role and group-based policy on the worker.

### 1/6 · W-P5-IDPA-01

**Add GroupResolver interface and multi-issuer OIDC config**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Create internal/idp with the GroupResolver interface, the `claims` adapter, and a resolver cache (TTL, staleTTL, singleflight). Extend internal/config with `identity.issuers[]` (strict-parsed, registered in the raw config so KnownFields(true) accepts it) and keep the single Dex issuer config as a one-element shorthand. Replace the single verifier with an issuer-keyed verifier map used by the console login, worker identity check and token service.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Existing Dex configs parse unchanged and produce identical roles in tests
- [ ] A token from an unconfigured issuer is rejected with 401 and an `unknown_issuer` log reason
- [ ] Cache returns stale groups within staleTTL on resolver error and empty groups after it

**Unblocks:** [`W-P5-IDPA-02`](idp-adapters.md#26--w-p5-idpa-02) Implement Okta group adapter; [`W-P5-IDPA-03`](idp-adapters.md#36--w-p5-idpa-03) Implement Entra groups adapter with Graph overage lookup; [`W-P5-IDPA-04`](idp-adapters.md#46--w-p5-idpa-04) Implement Google Admin Directory group adapter

### 2/6 · W-P5-IDPA-02

**Implement Okta group adapter**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue —

Add internal/idp/okta.go: read `groups` (or configured claim) from the ID token; when absent and `okta.apiTokenEnv` is set, call `GET {orgURL}/api/v1/users/{sub}/groups` with SSWS auth and paginate via Link headers. Use an httptest fake of the Okta API in unit tests.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Groups come from the claim when present without any API call
- [ ] Fallback API path handles pagination and 429 with Retry-After backoff
- [ ] API token never appears in logs or errors

**Depends on:** [`W-P5-IDPA-01`](idp-adapters.md#16--w-p5-idpa-01) Add GroupResolver interface and multi-issuer OIDC config

**Unblocks:** [`W-P5-IDPA-05`](idp-adapters.md#56--w-p5-idpa-05) Wire resolvers into console roles, worker identity and token service

### 3/6 · W-P5-IDPA-03

**Implement Entra groups adapter with Graph overage lookup**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add internal/idp/entra.go: use the `groups` claim when present; on overage (`_claim_names.groups` or `hasgroups=true`) get an app-only Graph token (client credentials, secret or cert from internal/secrets) and call `POST /v1.0/users/{oid}/getMemberGroups` with `securityEnabledOnly` from config. Optional name resolution via `directoryObjects/getByIds` behind `entra.resolveNames`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Overage token triggers exactly one Graph call per cache window (fake Graph server)
- [ ] Non-overage token resolves groups with no network call
- [ ] Graph 5xx falls back to cached groups and records a resolver-error metric

**Depends on:** [`W-P5-IDPA-01`](idp-adapters.md#16--w-p5-idpa-01) Add GroupResolver interface and multi-issuer OIDC config

**Unblocks:** [`W-P5-IDPA-05`](idp-adapters.md#56--w-p5-idpa-05) Wire resolvers into console roles, worker identity and token service

### 4/6 · W-P5-IDPA-04

**Implement Google Admin Directory group adapter**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Add internal/idp/google.go: build a JWT-bearer service-account token (scope `admin.directory.group.readonly`, `sub` = `google.adminSubject`) and call `GET admin/directory/v1/groups?userKey=<email>`; reject ID tokens whose `hd` does not match `google.hostedDomain`. Implement the token signing with the stdlib to avoid pulling the full Google SDK, consistent with internal/secrets/gcp.go keeping SDKs out of the tree.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Group emails are returned for a user in the configured domain (fake Directory server)
- [ ] Token with a different `hd` is rejected before any Directory call
- [ ] Service-account key is read through internal/secrets and is not persisted

**Depends on:** [`W-P5-IDPA-01`](idp-adapters.md#16--w-p5-idpa-01) Add GroupResolver interface and multi-issuer OIDC config

**Unblocks:** [`W-P5-IDPA-05`](idp-adapters.md#56--w-p5-idpa-05) Wire resolvers into console roles, worker identity and token service

### 5/6 · W-P5-IDPA-05

**Wire resolvers into console roles, worker identity and token service**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue —

Call GroupResolver after token verification in the console session login (p1-sso-roles), the worker identity attribute path, and the token-exchange handler so issued Warden tokens carry resolved `groups`. Worker-side resolution is skipped when tokens are minted by the CP token service (groups already in the 15-min JWT); direct-IdP tokens on the worker use the claims adapter only, so workers never hold directory credentials.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Console role and token-service `groups` claim match resolver output in an integration test per adapter
- [ ] Worker config never requires directory API credentials
- [ ] Group namespacing applies only when more than one issuer is configured

**Depends on:** [`W-P5-IDPA-02`](idp-adapters.md#26--w-p5-idpa-02) Implement Okta group adapter; [`W-P5-IDPA-03`](idp-adapters.md#36--w-p5-idpa-03) Implement Entra groups adapter with Graph overage lookup; [`W-P5-IDPA-04`](idp-adapters.md#46--w-p5-idpa-04) Implement Google Admin Directory group adapter

**Unblocks:** [`W-P5-IDPA-06`](idp-adapters.md#66--w-p5-idpa-06) Write per-IdP setup docs and a Dex-free compose example
